_meta.source: Round 16 - Direct CDS PDF extraction (SJSU, Portland State, CSULB, GMU, Dartmouth)
_meta.purpose: State university and Dartmouth residency admit rates from official CDS PDFs

schools.notes: SJSU CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 37,132 (in-state 35,162 / oos 1,197 / intl 773), admitted 31,419 (in-state 29,918 / oos 929 / intl 572). CSU school with high admit rates across all groups. Intl 74.0% notably lower than in-state 85.1%.

Portland State CDS 2023-24 C1: applied 8,877 (in-state 4,312 / oos 4,267 / intl 298), admitted 8,070 (in-state 3,951 / oos 3,840 / intl 279). Near-open admissions for all groups. Intl 93.6% slightly higher than domestic ~91%.

CSULB CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 83,951 (in-state 80,445 / oos 1,900 / intl 1,606), admitted 38,854 (in-state 36,892 / oos 1,390 / intl 572). Large CSU campus. Intl 35.6% notably lower than in-state 45.9%. OOS 73.2% higher than in-state (self-selected applicants).

GMU CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 25,234 (in-state 15,473 / oos 9,761 — intl not provided separately), admitted 22,074 (in-state 13,589 / oos 8,485). Enrolled 4,464 (in-state 3,610 / oos 660 / intl 194). OOS 86.9%, in-state 87.8% — very similar rates. Intl not reported in applied/admitted breakdown.

Dartmouth CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 31,656 (in-state 468 / oos 21,220 / intl 9,968), admitted 1,710 total. Table shows oos admitted ~988 (4.66% OOS rate) and unknown 170. In-state applied 468, enrolled 25 (~5.3% derived). Intl admit breakdown ambiguous from PDF extraction — not reported. Overall 5.40% (1710/31656).
